topics.label: Faithful reproduction
topics.rule: The ad explicitly claims that the instrument reproduces the pianist's playing exactly, faithfully or naturally, down to touch, nuance, dynamics, tempo, pedalling or 'every detail' (an accuracy/fidelity claim, not the mere statement that it 'reproduces the playing of' pianists).

examples.quote: gjengit av The Welte Mignon reproduktionsapparat med en absolut nøiagtighet saavel hvad angaar tempo, anslag og tonkvalitet som den correcte nuancering av foredraget
examples.gloss: reproduced by the Welte Mignon reproducing apparatus with absolute accuracy as regards tempo, touch and tone quality as well as the correct nuancing of the performance

examples.quote: Every shade and degree of accent, rhythm, and tone is duplicated perfectly and exactly as the Artist rendered it—nothing is added, nothing lost.
examples.gloss: (English original)

topics.label: Illusion of the living artist
topics.rule: The ad claims that the reproduction cannot be told apart from the live artist, or that it creates the sensation that the pianist is present or seated at the piano ('as if he sat at the instrument', 'close your eyes', 'the illusion is complete', 'its playing is the artist's playing').

examples.quote: Schliesst man :-: die Augen, so ist die Täuschung vollkommen.
examples.gloss: If one closes one's eyes, the illusion is complete.

examples.quote: you have but to close your eyes to feel the pres-ence of the master at the keys.
examples.gloss: (English original)

topics.label: Soul and personality of the artist
topics.rule: The ad says the instrument captures the artist's soul, spirit, personality, feeling, fire or musical essence — the inner, personal element beyond technique (references only to 'individual touch' or 'individual characteristics' go to A1).

examples.quote: The Welte-Mignon Autograph Piano Is the Living Soul of the Artist
examples.gloss: (English original)

examples.quote: Die auswechselbare Notenrolle ist die Musikseele des Meisters.
examples.gloss: The interchangeable music roll is the musical soul of the master.

topics.label: Art, not mechanism
topics.rule: The ad sets the instrument apart from mechanical or automatic players (pianola, 'self-playing instruments', the old electric piano), insists that it plays humanly and is no surrogate, or claims genuine artistic value or significance for it.

examples.quote: Viele glauben vielleicht, es handle sich um ein mechanisches, rein maschinenmässig spielendes Instrument, korrekt und präzis im Vortrag, aber ohne Wärme, Seele und Ausdruck! Nichts wäre irriger, als eine solche Ansicht.
examples.gloss: Many perhaps believe it is a mechanical instrument playing purely like a machine, correct and precise in performance but without warmth, soul and expression! Nothing could be more mistaken than such a view.

examples.quote: Until the Welte-Mignon made its appearance all the piano-playing 'instruments aimed at making the interpretation of a piece of music mechanically correct; the Welte-Mignon caught the great masters in the act of playing
examples.gloss: (English original)

topics.label: The artist hears himself
topics.rule: A pianist is reported or quoted as hearing his or her own recorded playing reproduced and recognising it as their own (or being deceived by it), or as authenticating the recordings as true to their playing.

examples.quote: Raoul Pugno: Es ist das erste Mal, dass ich mich selbst gehört habe. Ich habe mein Spiel genau wiedererkannt.
examples.gloss: Raoul Pugno: It is the first time that I have heard myself. I recognised my playing exactly.

examples.quote: the maestro instantly recognized his own touch, and after the jest was explained, he had the exquisite pleasure of hearing, for the first time, the outpouring of his own artistic soul.
examples.gloss: (English original)

topics.label: Phantom hands and the invisible pianist
topics.rule: Text or illustration shows keys moving with no one seated, ghostly or semi-transparent hands or pianist, or a piano playing by itself before listeners (the slogan 'The Master's Fingers on Your Piano' alone does not count).

examples.quote: WATCH the keys of your piano moving, though no one sits before it!
examples.gloss: (English original)

examples.quote: No one sits at the piano. Only the phantomhands of the masters touch the keys
examples.gloss: (English original)

topics.label: Testimonials of famous musicians
topics.rule: The ad quotes, or closely paraphrases, a named musician or other notable person (conductor, composer, novelist, court) praising the instrument.

examples.quote: Mignon ist für mich das unerreichte Ideal aller Musik-Instrumente , eine Erfindung von unschätzbarer Bedeutung für Lehrer, Schüler , Publikum und alle Künstler. Max Reger.
examples.gloss: For me Mignon is the unattained ideal of all musical instruments, an invention of inestimable importance for teachers, pupils, the public and all artists. Max Reger.

examples.quote: WILLIAM BACKHAUS, the celebrated Pianist, writes:—“For me this is one of the wonders of the world.”
examples.gloss: (English original)

topics.label: Collective and institutional endorsement
topics.rule: The ad claims endorsement in aggregate rather than by a quoted individual: 'all great artists', leading music authorities, critics or the musical press, conservatories and other institutions that bought or use it, or testimonials available on request.

examples.quote: wurde soeben vom k. k. österreichischen Ministerium für Kultus und Unterricht zu pädagogischen Zwecken für das Wiener Konservatorium angekauft.
examples.gloss: has just been purchased by the Imperial-Royal Austrian Ministry of Culture and Education for teaching purposes for the Vienna Conservatory.

examples.quote: kendt Verden over beundret og anbefalet af alle de største Musiknavne
examples.gloss: known the world over, admired and recommended by all the greatest names in music

topics.label: Royal and aristocratic prestige
topics.rule: The ad invokes royalty or aristocracy: royal or imperial owners and listeners, aristocratic audiences, or court-purveyor warrants and imperial insignia attached to the maker or the dealer.

examples.quote: When starting on a trip to Norway, the German Emperor ordered a WelteMignon Autograph Piano for his steam yacht.
examples.gloss: (English original)

examples.quote: De cómo se reúnen en las mansiones aristocráticas de Europa, sólo para oír la maravillosa e impecable ejecución de obras musicales en la “WELTE-MIGNON”
examples.gloss: How people gather in the aristocratic mansions of Europe just to hear the marvellous and impeccable performance of musical works on the Welte-Mignon

topics.label: Owners' satisfaction and social proof
topics.rule: The ad cites owners or buyers — named owners' letters, a typical buyer's voice ('That's why I bought it') — or the number of instruments placed or families that own one.

examples.quote: In den zwei Jahren, seit ich den Apparat besitze, hat derselbe stets sehr gut funktioniert und ist mir wie auch vielen anderen zu einer Quelle des schönsten Kunstgenusses geworden.
examples.gloss: In the two years since I have owned the apparatus it has always worked very well and has become for me, as for many others, a source of the finest artistic enjoyment.

examples.quote: "It brings the world's greatest pianists into my home ... That's why I bought it."
examples.gloss: (English original)

topics.label: Star pianist in the spotlight
topics.rule: The ad is built around one named celebrity pianist — headline, portrait, career story, recording-session photograph or anecdote — rather than a list of names.

examples.quote: Paderewski WILL Play Again Thanks to the wizardry of Hardman WelteMignon(licensee) Reproducing Pianos the art of Paderewski is imperishable .
examples.gloss: (English original)

examples.quote: OSSIP GABRILOWITSCH PIANISTE - VIRTUOSE ET DIRECTEUR DE LA SYMPHONIE DE DETROIT Jouera pour vous du Chopin, du Schumann, du Tschaïkowsky
examples.gloss: Ossip Gabrilowitsch, virtuoso pianist and conductor of the Detroit Symphony, will play Chopin, Schumann and Tchaikovsky for you

topics.label: Proof in public performance
topics.rule: The ad cites success in a public concert, theatre, exhibition or on the stage as proof of the instrument's quality, or stages a public demonstration (e.g. alongside a live pianist, or one piece by two pianists) designed to prove it.

examples.quote: Le grand succès du Steinway-Welte au dernier concert au Conservatoire a prouvé son éclatante supériorité dans la reproduction de jeu des maîtres du clavier
examples.gloss: The great success of the Steinway-Welte at the last concert at the Conservatoire has proved its brilliant superiority in reproducing the playing of the masters of the keyboard

examples.quote: M. Lambert's feat of playing alternately with the great Master's own actual reproduced playing will be of great interest to music lovers
examples.gloss: (English original)

topics.label: Hear it and be convinced
topics.rule: The ad challenges readers to listen for themselves, to compare it with rival instruments, or to test whether they can tell it from a live artist, asserting that hearing is believing.

examples.quote: Welte-Mignon (Licensee) Hear it—in comparison.
examples.gloss: (English original)

examples.quote: Sie werden das Spiel dieses Reproduktions-Klaviers wohl kaum von demjenigen eines Künstlers unterscheiden können. Interessiert Sie der Versuch?
examples.gloss: You will hardly be able to tell the playing of this reproducing piano from that of an artist. Are you interested in trying?

topics.label: Best in the world
topics.rule: Superlative or uniqueness claims about the instrument: the best, finest, most perfect, supreme or unsurpassed, the only true reproducer, superior to all other instruments, 'the last word'.

examples.quote: „Mignon“ Najlepszy fortepian artystyczny w świecie!
examples.gloss: 'Mignon', the best artistic piano in the world!

examples.quote: NO HAY NADA MEJOR, NI SE PUEDE PEDIR MAS
examples.gloss: There is nothing better, nor can one ask for more

topics.label: Wonder, miracle and magic
topics.rule: The instrument or its effect is called a wonder, miracle, marvel, magic or wizardry, or is said to astonish, amaze or be beyond belief.

examples.quote: Ein musikalisches Weltwunder.
examples.gloss: A musical wonder of the world.

examples.quote: It is modern magic.
examples.gloss: (English original)

topics.label: Landmark invention, novelty and progress
topics.rule: The instrument is framed as a great, ingenious or epoch-making invention, as a sensational novelty or the newest thing (including the first or only one in a country), or as the culmination of technical progress ('after many failures').

examples.quote: After Many Inventions and Many Failures— A PERFECT INSTRUMENT.
examples.gloss: (English original)

examples.quote: Nowością sensacyjną jest fortepian reprodukcyjny „Mignon” ... Najsłynniejsi artyści uznają „Mignon“ za wynalazek epokowy
examples.gloss: The reproducing piano 'Mignon' is a sensational novelty ... the most famous artists recognise 'Mignon' as an epoch-making invention

topics.label: Technology and the secret process
topics.rule: The ad foregrounds how the instrument works: electric or pneumatic drive, roll mechanism, the (secret, 'photographic') recording process, patents, technical features, or comparisons with photography or the phonograph. A product label such as 'electric reproducing piano' on its own does not count.

examples.quote: Through this secret photographic process possessed only by Welte-Mignon,* available only to Welte-Mignon* - the artist's playing is actually photographed
examples.gloss: (English original)

examples.quote: Der Mechanismus wird von einer Notenrolle, dem Gehirn des Apparates, gelenkt.
examples.gloss: The mechanism is guided by a music roll, the brain of the apparatus.

topics.label: The original and the first
topics.rule: The ad stresses that this is the original or first reproducing piano, the originators' invention and patents, the standard for all others, or warns against imitations and unknown makes posing as equivalent.

examples.quote: The WELTE-MIGNON Is the Original REPRODUCING PIANO And Was the First Ever Sold in the World
examples.gloss: (English original)

examples.quote: La WELTE MIGNON CO. fué la primera fábrica en el mundo que construyó y construye pianos REPRODUCTORES
examples.gloss: The Welte Mignon Co. was the first factory in the world to build, and it still builds, reproducing pianos

topics.label: World renown
topics.rule: The ad claims fame, admiration or triumph throughout the world or abroad ('world-famous', 'known the world over', 'a sensation abroad'); claims about the reach of the sales network do not count.

examples.quote: Van uit Amerika heeft de Estey-Welte reeds een triomftocht gemaakt door de geheele wereld.
examples.gloss: Starting from America, the Estey-Welte has already made a triumphal progress through the whole world.

examples.quote: »Mignon», som i utlandet väckt uppseende för korrekt återgifvande af pianisterna d'Alberts, Carrenos, Paderewskis m. fl. inspelade pianostycken
examples.gloss: 'Mignon', which has caused a sensation abroad for its correct reproduction of piano pieces recorded by the pianists d'Albert, Carreño, Paderewski and others

topics.label: Maker's heritage and awards
topics.rule: The ad invokes the Welte firm's age and history, the fame of its factory, or the prizes and medals it won at exhibitions.

examples.quote: M. Welte & Söhne G.m.b.H. Gegründet 1832.Freiburg in Baden. Vertreten an allen grösseren Plätzen der Welt. Erprobt in jedem Klima. Höchste Auszeichnungen auf allen Weltausstellungen.
examples.gloss: M. Welte & Söhne, founded 1832, Freiburg in Baden. Represented in all larger places of the world. Proven in every climate. Highest awards at all world exhibitions.

examples.quote: MEDALLAS DE ORO con que han sido premiados en las distintas Exposiciones los famosos pianos “WELTE MIGNON”
examples.gloss: Gold medals with which the famous Welte Mignon pianos have been awarded at the various exhibitions

topics.label: Quality and durability
topics.rule: The ad stresses solid construction, reliable functioning over time or in any climate, long life, or warns against cheap, jerry-built or unknown makes.

examples.quote: los cuales son construídos especialmente para el clima tropical, con caoba de Cuba teniendo todas las partes metálicas internas de cobre y bronce
examples.gloss: which are built especially for the tropical climate, of Cuban mahogany, with all internal metal parts of copper and bronze

examples.quote: It's the same with the jerry-built Player Piano—the cheap, inefficient instrument of which great numbers are now offered to the public.
examples.gloss: (English original)

topics.label: The masters at your command at home
topics.rule: The ad promises the playing of the great pianists in the buyer's own home or on his own piano, whenever he wishes (including the recurring slogan 'The Master's Fingers on Your Piano'); hearing them in the dealer's showroom does not count.

examples.quote: Das Reproduktions-Piano WelteMignon bietet die Möglichkeit, das Originalspiel der ersten Pianisten der Welt im eigenen Heim zu hören
examples.gloss: The Welte-Mignon reproducing piano offers the possibility of hearing the original playing of the world's foremost pianists in one's own home

examples.quote: With the Heintzman Welte-Mignon in your home, you can have the companionship of the world’s greatest pianists. Paderewski, De Pachmann, Hoffman and a host of others await your beck and call.
examples.gloss: (English original)

topics.label: Entertaining guests
topics.rule: The ad presents the instrument as a means of hosting: delighting guests, house concerts, dinner parties and dancing, frequent social functions (in the text or as a party scene in the illustration).

examples.quote: Ihre Gäste sind ganz entzückt wenn das WELTE-MIGNON ton- und klanggetreu das Meister-Spiel der ersten Klavierkünstler in Ihrem Heim erklingen läßt.
examples.gloss: Your guests are utterly delighted when the Welte-Mignon, true in tone and sound, lets the master playing of the foremost piano artists ring out in your home.

examples.quote: An ideal Instrument for homes where frequent social functions demand much entertaining, the WELTE will interest your guests and relieve the strain of hospitality.
examples.gloss: (English original)

topics.label: Domestic intimacy and leisure
topics.rule: The ad evokes family gatherings, the fireside, winter evenings, the privacy of the home or relaxed private leisure.

examples.quote: That delightful hour just after dinner—when the family is gathered around a cheery log fire—how you will enjoy the Welte-Mignon then!
examples.gloss: (English original)

examples.quote: Verschaft U zelf in 1921 het genot de grootste pianisten in Uwen huiselijken kring te hooren spelen.
examples.gloss: Grant yourself in 1921 the pleasure of hearing the greatest pianists play in your own family circle.

topics.label: Refinement and social distinction
topics.rule: The ad links the instrument with the refined, cultured or aristocratic home, with pride or privilege of ownership, or shows elegant society (evening dress, period salons) in its illustration.

examples.quote: Die Instrumente der Unsterblichen ... Ihre Kunst verewigt im vornehmen Heim
examples.gloss: The instruments of the immortals ... their art immortalised in the distinguished home

examples.quote: Uno de estos instrumentos en su hogar, es una representación evidente de su cultura musical.
examples.gloss: One of these instruments in your home is an evident sign of your musical culture.

topics.label: Ornament and furniture design
topics.rule: The ad praises the instrument's appearance as furniture: elegant exterior, an ornament for the salon, artistic or period case styles, a choice of designs and woods.

examples.quote: Elegant Ydre. En Pryd for enhver Salon.
examples.gloss: Elegant exterior. An ornament for any drawing room.

examples.quote: in the following period models FLORENTINE GRANDGEORGIAN WELTE-MIGNON LOUIS XVI GRANDLOUIS XV WELTE-MIGNON COLONIAL
examples.gloss: (English original)

topics.label: Women as owners, hostesses and listeners
topics.rule: The text addresses or features a woman (hostess, lady of the house, a woman relaxing) as the user of the instrument, or the illustration centres on a woman at or beside it.

examples.quote: Una mujer y un piano no deben faltar en ninguna casa...
examples.gloss: A woman and a piano should be missing from no home...

examples.quote: It is with pardonable pride that the hostess calls attention to her WelteMignon Licensee Reproducing Piano.
examples.gloss: (English original)

topics.label: Listening-circle imagery
topics.rule: The illustration shows two or more people gathered around the instrument, absorbed in listening.

examples.quote: [figure] Line drawing: an upright piano; in front of it two young women seated, and two men seated behind them, listening with their heads propped on their hands
examples.gloss: (English original)

examples.quote: [figure] a man and a woman seated on a sofa listen to a grand piano in the foreground, at which nobody sits
examples.gloss: (English original)

topics.label: Effortless: no skill needed
topics.rule: The ad stresses effortless operation — a press of a button, a single touch, plugging into any light socket, playing 'without human help' — or that no musical skill, effort or preparation is required of the owner.

examples.quote: Ein Druck auf den Knopf genügt, um einen d'Albert, Busoni, Paderewski, Reisenauer etc. zu zitieren.
examples.gloss: A press of the button is enough to summon a d'Albert, Busoni, Paderewski, Reisenauer etc.

examples.quote: paa hvilket De kan spille fuldstændig kunstnerisk uden nogensomhelst Forberedelse.
examples.gloss: on which you can play with complete artistry without any preparation whatsoever.

topics.label: Still a normal piano
topics.rule: The ad stresses that the instrument can also be played by hand, that the mechanism is invisible and leaves the piano's appearance and action unchanged, or that it can be played in several ways.

examples.quote: The Welte-Mignon* is invisible and does not interfere with manual playing.
examples.gloss: (English original)

examples.quote: kan op vier verschillende manieren bespeeld worden: 1e. met het klavier 2e. als reproductie-piano 3e. als kunstspel-instrument
examples.gloss: can be played in four different ways: 1. with the keyboard, 2. as a reproducing piano, 3. as a player instrument

topics.label: Within everyone's reach
topics.rule: The ad presents the instrument, and with it great music, as affordable or accessible to all ('within everyone's means', 'not out of your reach', 'at the price of an ordinary player'); a bare price or terms statement goes to the functional list.

examples.quote: We maintain that if music is to be enjoyed by everyone, it must be within everyone's reach.
examples.gloss: (English original)

examples.quote: Merveilleux! Oui, mais il vous est très facile d’avoir un de ces pianos chez vous.
examples.gloss: Marvellous! Yes, but it is very easy for you to have one of these pianos in your home.

topics.label: Repertoire breadth and evocative moods
topics.rule: The ad stresses the variety of music available (classics to dance and jazz, music for every mood or occasion), often painting the scenes and moods that the music conjures up.

examples.quote: Thunder of breaking waves; howl of the hurricane; crash of thunder; or, with your changing mood, mesmeric lure of the Lorelie's song; swinging measure of the Blue Danube
examples.gloss: (English original)

examples.quote: der kan erholdes et Repertoire omfattende saavel alle Klassikerne indspillet af Verdens betydeligste Virtuoser, som Øjeblikkets kendte og populære Danse.
examples.gloss: a repertoire can be obtained that includes all the classics recorded by the world's most important virtuosos as well as the well-known and popular dances of the moment.

topics.label: Seasonal occasions and gifts
topics.rule: The ad ties the purchase to a season or an occasion: summer, winter evenings, the holidays, a Christmas gift.

examples.quote: das denkbar vornehmste Weihnachtsgeschenk!
examples.gloss: the most distinguished Christmas present imaginable!

examples.quote: Pendant les VACANCES pour avoir des CONCERTS chez soi et entendre les meilleurs artistes
examples.gloss: During the holidays, to have concerts at home and hear the best artists

topics.label: Immortality and posterity
topics.rule: The ad claims that the instrument immortalises the artists, preserves their playing for posterity or future generations, or lets departed or retired artists play again.

examples.quote: Thru you I live forever." V. de Pachmann
examples.gloss: (English original)

examples.quote: Was grosse Meister unserer Tage leisten, kann nun nicht mehr untergehen und spätere Generationen werden die Früchte dieser genialen Erfindung geniessen.
examples.gloss: What the great masters of our day achieve can no longer perish, and later generations will enjoy the fruits of this ingenious invention.

topics.label: If only it had come earlier
topics.rule: The ad regrets that the invention did not exist in the time of Liszt, Chopin, Beethoven, Mozart, Rubinstein and others, whose playing is lost forever.

examples.quote: Man maa kun beklage at denne Opfindelse ikke allerede blev gjort tidligere; thi da kunde vi endnu den Dag i Dag høre Beethoven, Mozart og Chopin selv spille
examples.gloss: One can only regret that this invention was not made earlier, for then we could still hear Beethoven, Mozart and Chopin play themselves today

examples.quote: The regret of Musicians must ever be that this great invention was not brought out in 1809 instead of 1909.
examples.gloss: (English original)

topics.label: Education and study
topics.rule: The ad presents the instrument as an aid to teaching or study: conservatories, pupils and teachers, the close study of the masters' interpretations.

examples.quote: The Welte-Mignon Has a Faculty of One Hundred and Fifty-Six Instructors in Piano Playing
examples.gloss: (English original)

examples.quote: han hecho que este instrumento incomparable figure actualmente en los grandes conservatorios del mundo, para que discípulos y profesores se den cabal cuenta de la manera individual de interpretar de cada uno de los grandes “virtuosi” de la época.
examples.gloss: have brought this incomparable instrument into the great conservatories of the world, so that pupils and teachers can fully understand the individual manner of interpretation of each of the great virtuosos of the day.

topics.label: Artistic enjoyment and cultural uplift
topics.rule: The ad presents the instrument as a source of true artistic enjoyment (Kunstgenuss), of good or art music in the home, or of ennobling, 'better' entertainment.

examples.quote: Ein Vergnügen ist je nach seiner Art von gutem oder minder gutem Einfluss auf den Menschen. Musikalische Unterhaltung edelster Art bringt Welte-Mignon.
examples.gloss: A pleasure has, according to its kind, a good or a less good influence on people. Welte-Mignon brings musical entertainment of the noblest kind.

examples.quote: KUNSTMUSIK i Hjemmet.
examples.gloss: Art music in the home.

topics.label: Versatile uses and venues
topics.rule: The ad names uses beyond private solo listening: accompanying singers or dancers, stage use, or venues such as concert halls, hotels, restaurants, hospitals and institutes.

examples.quote: För hem, konsertsalonger, musikinstitut, sjukhus, sanatorier, klubblokaler, förstkl. restauranger m. m. blir ”Mignon” en stor ackvisition.
examples.gloss: For homes, concert salons, music institutes, hospitals, sanatoria, club rooms, first-class restaurants etc., the 'Mignon' will be a great acquisition.

examples.quote: Many recordings by notable accompanists afford competent support for singing at any time.
examples.gloss: (English original)

topics.label: Composers play their own works
topics.rule: The ad stresses that composers themselves recorded, or are heard playing, their own compositions.

examples.quote: Kom in och låt oss spela en komposition av Sjögren eller Stenhammar, inspelade av kompositörerna själva.
examples.gloss: Come in and let us play a composition by Sjögren or Stenhammar, recorded by the composers themselves.

examples.quote: Grieg: Schmetterling Vøglein. Brudefølget drager forbi. Samtlige spillet af Edv. Grieg.
examples.gloss: Grieg: Butterfly, Little Bird, The Bridal Procession Passes By. All played by Edv. Grieg.

topics.label: National pride
topics.rule: The ad appeals to national or local pride (German inventive spirit, home industry, the honour of the Canadian name, a famous Canadian pianist).

examples.quote: Deutschem Erfindungsgeist ist es geglückt, eine geradezu phantastisch erscheinende Idee - ein akustisches Seitenstück zur Platte des Photo-graphen - zu verwirklichen.
examples.gloss: German inventive genius has succeeded in realising an idea that seems downright fantastic: an acoustic counterpart to the photographer's plate.

examples.quote: ce piano qui fait honneur au nom canadien
examples.gloss: this piano that does honour to the Canadian name

functional.label: Dealer identification with exclusive / sole agency claim
Invitation to a demonstration, audition or showroom visit
Public concerts, recitals, exhibitions and fairs (date, venue, programme, tickets)
Trade-in / exchange of the old piano
Artist roster (lists of recording pianists, portrait galleries)
Model range, types and host piano makes (incl. "available in 115 makes")
Roll library / repertoire size and new recordings
Dealer / firm credentials (largest, oldest, founded, court purveyor)
Trade-directed (dealer franchise, agents wanted, trade shows)
